questions.text: What is the first source-backed move in geological-hazard site planning?

options.text: Read hazard, exposure, vulnerability, soil, slope, and drainage evidence before fixing the building footprint.
Place the building first and classify the hazard after construction.
Ignore mapped hazards when the lot has a clear title.
Treat all slopes as equal if the floor area is unchanged.

questions.rationale: Read hazard, exposure, vulnerability, soil, slope, and drainage evidence before fixing the building footprint. This answer is supported by the checked local raw-source families for Geological Hazards.

Use the same site layout regardless of floodplain or slope exposure.
Replace hazard mapping with facade material selection.
